_meta.why: discover.py sweeps only get* methods, so discovery.json contains no setters at all. These names were recovered from the router's own UI bundle /static/js/main.<hash>.js and confirmed against the device.
_meta.how_to_repeat: fetch the bundle referenced by GET / and grep for '"(set|change|add|delete|edit)[A-Za-z]+"'; the call sites carry the params object literally.

notes: invalidates the current session on success
router rate-limits failed logins and locks the account for minutes
returns null if vlanID is omitted, which looks like 'no reservations'
takes the COMPLETE list and replaces it; the name says add
an address with no existing DHCP lease is rejected SILENTLY - result null, list unchanged, no error. Tested with an out-of-pool address and a free in-pool one; both dropped.
